senses.gloss: 2. लुप् (in gram.) falling out, suppression, elision (cf. 2. लुक्)
लुप् mfn. = लुप्त, fallen out, dropped, elided, VPrāt.
लुप्त mfn. broken, violated, hurt, injured, VarBṛS.
robbed, plundered, (ifc.) deprived of Kauś.; MBh. &c.
suppressed, lost, destroyed, annihilated, disappeared, ĀśvŚr.; MBh. &c.
(in gram.) dropped, elided, Prāt.; Pāṇ. &c.
(in rhet.) elliptical (as opp. to पूर्ण, ‘complete’), Vām.; Kpr.
लुप्त n. stolen property, plunder, booty, L.
(prob.) disappearance (cf. शश-ल्˚).
लुप्त—ता f. the state of being cut off or divided, disappearance, nonexistence, W.
लुप्त—दण्डक m. (prob.) an arch-rogue, Mṛcch.
लुप्त—धर्म-क्रिय mfn. excluded from or deprived of religious ordinances, Mn. viii, 226.
लुप्त—पद mfn. wanting (whole) words, W.
लुप्त—पिण्डोदक-क्रिय mfn. deprived of funeral rites, Bhag.
लुप्त—प्रतिभ mfn. deprived of reason, Rājat.
लुप्त—विसर्ग mfn. dropping the Visarga, Sāh.
लुप्त—विसर्ग n. = next, Pratāp.
लुप्त—विसर्ग—क n. (ib.)
लुप्त—विसर्ग—ता f. (Sāh.) absence of Visarga.
लुप्ताहत-विसर्ग mfn. having Visarga dropped or coalesced (with a preceding a) into ओ (-ता f.), Sāh.
लुप्ताहत-विसर्ग—ता f.
लुप्तोपम mfn. wanting or omitting the particle of comparison, Nir.
लुप्तोपमा f. (in rhet.) a mutilated or imperfect simile (the conjunction expressing comparison or the common attribute being omitted), Vām., Kpr. &c. (IW. 458).
लुप्तोपमान mfn. = prec. mfn., Mahīdh.
